subject: orthopaedics
title: Complications of fractures: early threats to late failures

steps.tx: Femur or pelvis fractures can bleed litres into tissues, so **shock** needs early blood with balanced ratios. Long bone marrow may trigger **fat embolism**, judged by Gurd major and minor criteria, with hypoxia, confusion and chest or axilla petechiae about twelve to seventy two hours after injury. Give oxygen, fluids and ventilation as needed, watching saturation and urine output. Calf symptoms scored by Wells warn of thrombosis and embolism, so begin prophylaxis early. **Crush** injury releases myoglobin that harms kidneys, and contused lungs can progress to ARDS.
steps.say: Fractures of the femur or pelvis can bleed litres into the tissues, so you should recognise shock early and restore volume with blood in balanced ratios. Marrow from long bone fractures can trigger fat embolism, which you judge with Gurd major and minor criteria, classically hypoxia with confusion and petechiae across the chest and axilla about twelve to seventy two hours after injury. You should give oxygen with fluids and ventilation when needed, while you track saturation and urine output closely. Calf symptoms scored with Wells warn of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism, so you must begin prophylaxis early. Crush injury releases myoglobin that harms the kidneys, and a contused lung can progress to ARDS.

steps.tx: The photograph shows scattered **petechiae** across the upper chest and axilla, which is the rash you must spot for the exam. In a patient with a recent long bone fracture, this rash completes the **fat embolism** triad together with **hypoxia** and confusion. It typically blooms about twelve to seventy two hours after injury, when marrow fat reaches the lungs and brain. Finding this rash should prompt oxygen assessment, mental status review and urgent supportive care with prophylaxis against further thromboembolism.
steps.say: This photograph shows scattered petechiae across the upper chest and axilla, and you must learn to recognise this rash for the exam. When it appears in a patient with a recent long bone fracture, it completes the fat embolism triad alongside hypoxia and confusion. The rash usually appears about twelve to seventy two hours after injury as marrow fat spreads to the lungs and the brain. When you find it, you should assess oxygenation at once, review the mental status, and arrange urgent supportive care with prophylaxis against further thromboembolism.

steps.tx: A tense limb with pain out of proportion and agony on passive stretch signals **compartment** syndrome, ahead of the classic five Ps of pain, pallor, pulselessness, paraesthesia and paralysis. A delta pressure within thirty of diastolic confirms danger. Split tight casts, elevate, and recheck neurovascular status hourly, but definitive care is emergency **fasciotomy** to release every involved compartment. Missed ischaemia hardens into **Volkmann** contracture with median clawing. Open Gustilo wounds need urgent debridement, crepitant gas gangrene needs penicillin with surgery, and a pulseless limb needs vessel repair.
steps.say: You should suspect compartment syndrome when a tense limb shows pain out of proportion with agony on passive stretch, even before the five Ps of pain with pallor, pulselessness, paraesthesia and paralysis appear. A delta pressure within thirty of diastolic confirms the danger. You must split tight casts, elevate the limb, and recheck neurovascular status every hour, but definitive treatment is emergency fasciotomy that releases every involved compartment. Missed ischaemia hardens into Volkmann contracture with median clawing. Open Gustilo wounds need urgent debridement, crepitant gas gangrene needs penicillin with surgery, and a pulseless limb needs vessel repair.

steps.tx: A fracture that heals slowly but keeps progressing shows delayed union, while one stagnant at nine months with three months of no progress meets **nonunion**. Atrophic ends look tapered and avascular, whereas hypertrophic ends sprout exuberant elephant foot callus from excess motion. A fluid filled false joint is **pseudoarthrosis**, and healing in varus, valgus, overlap or shortening is **malunion**. Cross union between radius and ulna blocks rotation. Restore stability with compression plating or nail exchange, restore biology with graft, and revise when exchange is indicated.
steps.say: You should call healing delayed when a fracture progresses slowly but keeps moving toward union, and you should diagnose nonunion when it stays stagnant at nine months with three months of no progress. Atrophic ends look tapered and avascular from poor biology, whereas hypertrophic ends sprout exuberant callus because excess motion persists. A fluid filled false joint is pseudoarthrosis, while healing in varus or valgus with overlap or shortening is malunion. Cross union between the radius and ulna blocks forearm rotation. You restore stability with compression plating or nail exchange, restore biology with bone graft, and revise the fixation when exchange is indicated.

steps.tx: The femoral head, scaphoid and talus lose blood supply easily, so **AVN** declared over months needs Garden style assessment and joint preserving care where possible. Never massage an injured elbow or apply hot packs, because **myositis** ossificans seeds bone in soft tissue. Burning glossy stiffness after minor trauma is **Sudeck** dystrophy until proven otherwise. Incongruent joints wear into arthritis, injured physes arrest into angular short limbs, weak callus refractures, loose implants break, and neglected movement stiffens, so supervised physiotherapy with years of review prevents decline.
steps.say: The femoral head with the scaphoid and talus loses blood supply easily, so avascular necrosis declares itself over months and needs careful assessment with joint preserving care wherever possible. You must never massage an injured elbow or apply hot packs, because myositis ossificans seeds bone inside soft tissue. Burning glossy stiffness after minor trauma is Sudeck dystrophy until proven otherwise. Incongruent joints wear into arthritis, injured growth plates arrest into angular short limbs, weak callus refractures, and loose implants break. Neglected movement stiffens every joint, so supervised physiotherapy with years of review prevents decline.
